parties.respondent: The Consortium Of Mr. Murari Lal Jalan and Mr. Florian Fritsch

summary: Resolution Plan implementation dispute; Conditions Precedent compliance; PBG adjustment impermissible under IBC; airport dues and employee dues non-payment; liquidation consequence under Section 33(3) not automatic; timeliness as objective; NCLAT directions on PBG improper; effective date fixation confirmed; non-fulfilment consequences analyzed; impugned judgment partially set aside.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed in part; NCLAT judgment modified; Performance Bank Guarantee not to be adjusted against first tranche; liquidation not ordered.
